verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for a tax agency's online filing and payment flow, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host). Neither says whether such limits are disclosed up front, so with no evidence of the capability the verdict is none. Confidence is low because the relevant pages could not be read at all.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
